text_block_list.text: With the Classic Year about to begin—along with the races for the ultimate goal, the Triple Tiara—we were holding a thorough strategy meeting on this day.

Following the plan set after her debut race...
focusing mainly on training while gradually entering
races, the result was――
choice_data_list: You've cleared quite a few hurdles, too.
You've cleared quite a few hurdles, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Being able to draw out my instincts at will is one thing, but..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The reason I stopped collapsing when holding it back...
must be thanks to taking my training step by step.
choice_data_list: Let's keep this up and do our best in the race too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes!
choice_data_list: Well, let's head home. I'll walk you back.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "No matter the time... you always walk me back to the dorms, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Why is that?
choice_data_list: Why? Well... because it'd be awful if something happened.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However... the dorms are right in front of the academy,
and I'm... well, at least stronger
than the average person physically.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Besides... as you can see, I usually keep a low profile.
I doubt anything will happen...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be that you're worried
my instincts might go wild...?"
choice_data_list: That's part of it. But that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: Because I promised to protect you.
Because I promised I'd protect you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
!
Ah—
—If anything happens, this time I will protect you no matter what.

"Of course, I also want to make sure she gets back safely
in her unstable state... but above all,
I just want to protect her. Strong or weak, that doesn't matter—"
choice_data_list: So that you don't get hurt more than necessary.
So that you don't get hurt more than necessary.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

The path she walks is bound to be steep and harsh.
I cannot smooth it out for her...
If so, I at least wanted to give her peace of mind.
choice_data_list: If it's alright with you, let me walk you the rest of the way.
If it's alright with you, let me walk you the rest of the way.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: A bother? Not at all...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so glad.
Thank... you very much."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —...I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—I wish we could have chatted
a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (I can't... act so selfishly. Not to someone who's so kind...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...How on earth should I repay this favor?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I have received so much... so many things.
To repay that person...)

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text: —There is only one.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I know.
After all, they are a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(There is only one way to repay them.
—Through victory alone.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Only a glorious achievement.
That's right—only the Triple Tiara...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —It's futile.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am different. Love...
—means nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—...No.
You are mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haa...! Haa...!
...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—It's already past curfew.
Just how long do you plan on running?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
...Air Groove-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
I'll be out of your hair in just a moment—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So, we're training outside?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I have submitted my night curfew extension request.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's not what I mean.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you been pushing yourself too hard lately?
I know an important race is coming up, but...
you'll ruin your body at this rate.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
This has nothing to do
with you, Air Groove-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That may be so. However,
you're an important junior too, and—

text_block_list.name: Facility Staff Member
text_block_list.text: —You, too, are our precious child.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you want underclassmen, there are plenty of others.
...Please leave me be.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —I don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't let anyone step inside my heart.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll get stronger on my own...
and win, all by myself. And then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I will prove that I can win—
even without love."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —I will prove it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I won't let anyone say... that these feelings were meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I shall prove it.
No matter who my opponent may be—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —No matter how unseemly I might look.
